text:
nina: dropped a slim-table prototype + alternate badge hierarchy for the compare view. Main ask: do we surface perf badges or trust the tooltip? https://f.link/compare-slim :mag
emily: very helpful. my instinct: surface 1 perf badge (latency) + a neutral 'more' icon. performance is our main decision metric in many flows
tom: engineering constraints: adding a new column breaks some table virtualization assumptions. better to tuck perf into a narrow right-aligned cell rather than adding columns
jose: UX note: if we show only one badge we must allow keyboard users to expand the rest. suggested pattern: focusable chip that opens a small popover with keyboard traps
ina: agreed. also worried about copy for the persistent pin action. current hover text reads 'Pin' — ambiguous. propose 'Keep version pinned' vs 'Pin for this session' in the row menu
li: accessibility: contrast on the gold perf badge fails AA on dark mode. either tweak hue or use an outlined badge with icon + text. also add aria-describedby linking to the tooltip content
emily: A/B idea: show full badges by default for wide tables, collapse into single badge for <900px. measure clicks on the 'more' chip and time-to-compare completion
ina: question re: version pin icon — should it be filled when persistent and outlined for session-only? that might help visual recognition
ina: added a quick frame with that state in figma (frame 7-9)
ux-bot: New comment on file: https://f.link/compare-slim#c2 
tom: dev plan: implement session-only pin using client state first. I'll add a route query param so permalink preserves pinned selection. persistent version requires new endpoints, put on backlog
jose: keyboard shortcuts: suggest 'v' to toggle pin on focused row. make sure we have visible announcement for screen readers when a pin is added/removed
ina: copy for empty compare when a pinned version is filtered out: "Your pinned version is hidden by filters. Clear filters or unpin to continue." shorter: "Pinned version filtered out"
li: small color test: I'll push three alternative hex options in the figma file. prefer the one with higher contrast and an icon fallback
emily: decision call: prioritize touch-friendly popover for 'more' chip and session-first pin. we'll revisit persistent pins after metrics from the A/B test
ina: I'll update the design doc with acceptance criteria (keyboard nav, contrast tokens, tooltip copy, route param). tagging @tom for implementation follow-up
tom: ok I'll open a ticket and post the RFC with perf implications by EOD :white_check_mark:
